engineeringSkip.reason: A speculative mash-up of mycelium materials, bioluminescence and coral that lacks a coherent engineering basis or research programme.

factCheck.reason: Glowing buildings grown from fungi and coral are not a technology anyone is developing — the tile welds together two real but separate research areas (mycelium building blocks and engineered bioluminescence) into the incoherent claim that light-emitting genes could also hold a structure up.
